Privacy policy

Leo Dinoland · LeoPlay Studio
Last updated: 3 October 2026

A children’s game without accounts, advertising or analytics. Progress stays on the device. Here we also explain what happens when an adult makes a purchase, contacts us or visits this page online.

1. Who is responsible

The data controller is Alessio Scarano, the developer operating as LeoPlay Studio. Support and privacy contact: leoplay.studio@gmail.com. This policy covers Leo Dinoland for Android (com.leodinoland.game), support communications and its privacy web page.

2. Children, accounts and permissions

Leo Dinoland is primarily designed for children aged 4–7. It does not require an app account or the child’s name, email address or date of birth. There are no ads, chat, social features, analytics or profiling tools. We do not sell data or use gameplay data for marketing.

The app does not request camera, microphone, location or contacts access and does not use the advertising ID. Settings, purchases and external links are in the protected Parents area. The game does not record the child’s voice or image.

3. Local gameplay data

The device stores language, audio and animation preferences, unlocked and completed levels, egg progress, collected hatchlings, museum arrangements and drafts, map position and the initial hint state. A limited history of recent results for each game is also stored, including date, completion, errors and use of help. This remembers progress and choices; it is not sent to LeoPlay Studio servers.

Coloring drawings remain temporarily in memory while the activity is open; they are not uploaded or saved in a permanent gallery. We do not offer cloud saves or progress syncing between devices. Images, music and effects are bundled with the app: gameplay data is not sent to artificial intelligence services.

4. Optional purchase through Google Play

An adult may buy the one-time full unlock, identified as full_unlock. The purchase component communicates with Google Play to show the price and check, make, acknowledge or restore a purchase; the status may also be checked when starting or returning to the app. The component handles the product identifier, status, receipt and technical purchase token. We do not use a LeoPlay Studio server or external validation service to receive them.

The app does not receive card numbers, Google account credentials or payment instrument details. Google processes account, payment and transaction data under its own terms. The developer may receive administrative order and sales information through Play Console, used for purchase management, support and applicable obligations, not to profile children.

Gameplay activities work offline. Purchases, restoration, store checks and links voluntarily opened may use an internet connection.

5. Support, purposes and legal bases

If a parent emails us, we receive their email address, message and any attachments or order references they choose to send. We use these to respond and handle problems, purchases and privacy requests. Please do not send the child’s name, photos or other personal data, passwords or card details. The support mailbox is hosted by Gmail, a Google service.

Where the GDPR applies, processing necessary to provide the purchase or requested support is based on performance of a contract or pre-contractual steps; processing required by law is based on those obligations. Handling other requests and preventing abuse is based on our legitimate interest in providing support and protecting the service, respecting people’s rights, especially children’s rights. We do not carry out profiling or automated decisions with legal effects.

6. Web page and external providers

The online version of this policy is hosted on GitHub Pages. When you visit it, GitHub may process your IP address and technical request data to deliver and protect the service. The page contains no forms, trackers, analytics, remote fonts or cookies added by LeoPlay Studio. The in-app copy is bundled and works offline: reading it does not contact GitHub.

Google and GitHub may process data outside the European Economic Area under the terms and safeguards described in their respective policies, linked below. Local progress is not transferred by LeoPlay Studio to these providers. Information may be disclosed to authorities when required by law.

7. Retention, security and deletion

Saves remain in app storage until deleted. “Reset progress” in the Parents area deletes progress, hatchlings, the museum and map preferences and resets game settings, preserving the chosen language. It does not cancel purchases or erase orders held by Google. The unlock can be restored through the relevant Google Play account.

To remove all local data, clear the app’s data in Android settings or uninstall it. The app configuration disables Android backup. We cannot remotely delete device saves. Temporary drawings are released when leaving the coloring activity.

Support messages are retained for as long as necessary to handle the request and follow-up; further retention is limited to legal obligations or protection of rights. Google’s and GitHub’s retention periods depend on their respective policies. Local data is protected by operating-system isolation; the public page uses HTTPS. We never ask for passwords or card details by email.

8. Rights and updates

For data we handle, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability and objection, where applicable, by emailing leoplay.studio@gmail.com. A parent or guardian may act for the child. For progress stored only on your device, use the local controls. No account is required.

You can complain to the Italian Garante per la protezione dei dati personali or the competent authority in your country. If practices change, we will update this policy and its date, providing any required information and choices before new processing.
